shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx' tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; git diff package.json

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -rl "runtime prefetch\|runtimePrefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rli "runtime prefetch" . | head; echo ---; grep -rn -i -B2 -A12 "runtime prefetch" 01-app/01-getting-started/*cache-components* 2>/dev/null | head -150

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rli "prefetch" . | head -20; echo ---; grep -rn -i "prefetch" 01-app/01-getting-started/*cache* 01-app/*/*cacheLife* 01-app/*/*/*cacheLife* 2>/dev/null | head -60
pwd; sed -n 230,300p 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md; echo ======; grep -rn -i -A6 "prefetch" 01-app/01-getting-started/*cache-components* | head -120
ls 01-app/01-getting-started/ 01-app/02-guides | head -80; grep -rli "cacheComponents\|cache components" . | head -20

cat 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/instant.md; echo; echo =====================; cat 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/prefetch.md
cat 01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md
cat 01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md

cat 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md; echo =====; cat 01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md; echo =====; grep -n -i -A8 "^### \`prefetch\`\|prefetch={true}\|prefetch=\"auto\"\|prefetch prop" 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80

cd /workspace && grep -o "unstable_navigation\|unstable_prefetch" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u; grep -rn "unstable_navigation" node_modules/next/cache.js node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn "partialPrefetching" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

git status --short; grep -rhoE "NEXT_ROUTER_[A-Z_]*PREFETCH[A-Z_]*_HEADER = '[^']*'|NEXT_RUNTIME_PREFETCH[A-Z_]* = '[^']*'|RSC_HEADER = '[^']*'" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | sort -u

grep -rhoE "next-router-prefetch[^'\"]*|'next-runtime-prefetch[^']*'|Next-Router-Prefetch[^'\"]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/router-utils/*.js node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head; grep -rn "runtime-prefetch\|runtimePrefetch\|isRuntimePrefetch" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js | head -8
sed -n 195,215p node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- warm cache via a real navigation request (first request fills 'use cache') ---"; time curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'rsc: 1' http://localhost:3123/projects/acme
for kind in "2 per-link-prefetch" "3 app-shell-prefetch"; do set -- $kind; echo; echo "=== next-router-prefetch: $1 ($2) ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -s -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $1" http://localhost:3123/projects/acme); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms"; echo -n "title 'Acme Storefront' present: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Acme Storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details 'Commerce storefront' present: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Commerce storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "'Loading details...' fallback present: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Loading details" && echo yes || echo no; done
echo; echo "=== full navigation (rsc: 1) ==="; out=$(curl -s -H 'rsc: 1' http://localhost:3123/projects/acme); echo -n "title: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Acme Storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Commerce storefront" && echo yes || echo no
cat /tmp/next-start.log; curl -s -i -H 'rsc: 1' http://localhost:3123/projects/acme | head -20

U='http://localhost:3123/projects/acme?_rsc=1'; curl -s -o /dev/null -H 'rsc: 1' "$U"; sleep 1
for kind in "2 per-link-prefetch" "3 app-shell-prefetch" "1 static-prefetch"; do set -- $kind; echo; echo "=== next-router-prefetch: $1 ($2) ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -s -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $1" "$U"); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms, ${#out} bytes"; echo -n "title 'Acme Storefront': "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Acme Storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details 'Commerce storefront': "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Commerce storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "'Loading details...' fallback: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Loading details" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "'Loading project...' fallback: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Loading project" && echo yes || echo no; done
echo; echo "=== full navigation (rsc: 1) ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -s -H 'rsc: 1' "$U"); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms"; echo -n "title: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Acme Storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Commerce storefront" && echo yes || echo no
curl -s -i -H 'rsc: 1' 'http://localhost:3123/projects/acme?_rsc=1' | head -30; echo ....; curl -s -i -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3123/projects/acme?_rsc=1' | head -30

U='http://localhost:3123/projects/acme'; curl -sL -o /dev/null -H 'rsc: 1' "$U"; sleep 1
for kind in "2 per-link-prefetch" "3 app-shell-prefetch" "1 static-prefetch"; do set -- $kind; echo; echo "=== next-router-prefetch: $1 ($2) ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -sL -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $1" "$U"); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms, ${#out} bytes"; echo -n "title 'Acme Storefront': "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Acme Storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details 'Commerce storefront': "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Commerce storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "'Loading details...' fallback: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Loading details" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "'Loading project...' fallback: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Loading project" && echo yes || echo no; done
echo; echo "=== full navigation (rsc: 1) ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -sL -H 'rsc: 1' "$U"); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms"; echo -n "title: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Acme Storefront" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Commerce storefront" && echo yes || echo no

U='http://localhost:3123/projects/orbit'; echo "=== per-link prefetch of never-visited /projects/orbit ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -sL -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: 2" "$U"); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms"; echo -n "title 'Orbit Analytics': "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Orbit Analytics" && echo yes || echo no; echo -n "details 'Product analytics': "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Product analytics" && echo yes || echo no
echo; echo "=== then the navigation itself ==="; start=$(date +%s%N); out=$(curl -sL -H 'rsc: 1' "$U"); end=$(date +%s%N); echo "took $(( (end-start)/1000000 ))ms (details fetched here, ~800ms expected)"; echo -n "details: "; echo "$out" | grep -q "Product analytics" && echo yes || echo no
pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; true
cat .gitignore; echo ---; git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && git status --short && echo --- && git diff -- next.config.ts app/
